note: Directives are expressed over the machine's declared adaptable surface. Values are ranges; the model selects within them and must stay inside the machine's own declared ranges, which always take precedence.

skills.rationale: Reduced visual acuity requires larger rendered text. WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 expects content to remain usable when scaled; enlarging the typographic scale rather than zooming preserves layout control.
skills.degradation: If the machine caps font-scale below the requested range, use the cap and raise line-height and padding instead.

skills.rationale: Ambient glare and reduced contrast sensitivity lower effective legibility. WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 sets 4.5:1 for body text; industrial lighting warrants a higher working target.
skills.degradation: Never restyle protected safety selectors; raise contrast on surrounding surfaces instead.

skills.rationale: Colour vision deficiency makes hue-only encoding unreliable. WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 requires that colour is not the sole carrier of meaning; luminance separation is the robust substitute.

low.strategy: increase luminance separation between surface and text

moderate.strategy: avoid red-green pairings, widen luminance separation

high.strategy: use a luminance-ordered neutral palette for non-safety surfaces

skills.degradation: If the palette cannot be changed without touching protected selectors, adjust borders only.

skills.rationale: Gloves, tremor or reduced dexterity enlarge effective pointer error. WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 sets a 24px minimum target; industrial use with gloves needs substantially more, plus spacing to limit mis-activation.
skills.degradation: If enlarging targets would overflow the viewport, hide hideable panels first, then reduce the target increment.

skills.rationale: Layouts assume right-hand reach. Repositioning frequent controls within the natural arc of the dominant hand reduces cross-body reaching (ISO 9241-210 ergonomic fit).

moderate.strategy: reverse control order and panel order

high.strategy: reverse control and panel order, bias padding toward the dominant side

skills.degradation: Reordering must never move a protected safety element; leave its position untouched.

skills.rationale: Reading difficulty benefits from wider inter-letter and inter-line spacing more than from larger glyphs. WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.12 defines text-spacing thresholds that must remain usable.
skills.degradation: If spacing causes truncation in metric values, cap letter-spacing before reducing line-height.

skills.rationale: Elevated workload narrows attention. Reducing the number of simultaneously competing regions lowers visual search cost; locked panels carry operational risk information and must remain.
skills.degradation: Hide only panels listed as hideable; if fewer are available than requested, hide all available ones and stop.

skills.rationale: When tactile or auditory confirmation is degraded, visual acknowledgement must carry more weight, so confirmation affordances are given greater visual prominence.

high.control_emphasis: raise border weight and surface separation

skills.degradation: If the machine declares audio or haptic capability, prefer those channels and keep visual changes minimal.

skills.rationale: When direct manipulation is unreliable, an alternative modality reduces dependence on fine motor control. The modality must be declared by the machine; it cannot be assumed.

low.strategy: no visual change unless capability is declared

moderate.strategy: enlarge primary controls if no alternative modality is available

high.strategy: enlarge primary controls and increase spacing if no alternative modality is available

skills.degradation: If the machine declares neither voice_input nor haptic, fall back to coarse-pointing directives at one level lower.

skills.rationale: Motion sensitivity and fatigue are aggravated by animated or high-frequency visual change. Reducing chromatic activity lowers perceived visual noise on static interfaces.

low.strategy: reduce saturation of non-safety surfaces slightly

high.strategy: use desaturated neutral surfaces outside safety elements

skills.degradation: Desaturation must not reduce any measured contrast below the machine minimum.
